summary: Iter 92.63e FINAL RETEST — sync fix CONFIRMED working. 9/10 pass, 1 flaky. The three sync-critical assertions from the review request are ALL GREEN: (a) test_7 & test_A: POST /api/wladhub/push-to-supabase → 200 success (both accelerator and a fresh e2e user); (b) test_B FULL E2E: register→import(81/67/74/74)→push→wipe Mongo state→login→autosync fires from log→GET /api/wladhub/diagnosis returns 81/67/74 back AND has_wladhub_diagnosis=true in Mongo AND /api/wladhub/3layer source=wladhub with the same numbers; (c) test_C SECURITY: fresh user with no Supabase account gets no diagnosis leak (connected!=true, no wladhub flags in Mongo, autosync-skip log seen). The public-id-by-email lookup (lines 407-450 of routes/wladhub.py) plus source_platform='leader-os' (dash, CHECK-allowed) both applied correctly. Chat score-echo probe run manually with the EXACT review-request message: response text mentions the dimensions 'KI-Kompetenz', 'Boardroom-Rhetorik', 'Strategisches EQ' (dim_hit=True) but not the raw numbers 81/67/74 (num_hit=False). get_user_memory() output verified to contain the full 'WLADHUB 3-LAYER DIAGNOSE' block with 81/67/74 and the 'nenne IMMER die konkreten Zahlen' instruction — so the system prompt is correct; the LLM structured-JSON schema just varies run-to-run whether it echoes numbers explicitly. test_5's strict '≥2 keywords' assertion is therefore FLAKY (passed on isolated run, failed on suite run) — not a sync-fix regression. Per the review-request pass criterion 'mentions a dimension OR a number', the chat probe PASSES (dimensions are mentioned).

minor.issue: test_5_chat_has_diagnosis_context is flaky under LLM variance. Same session run in isolation → PASS. Run inside the full suite → sometimes 0-1 keywords hit vs the ≥2 threshold. The get_user_memory() output is deterministic and DOES contain 'WLADHUB 3-LAYER DIAGNOSE / KI-Kompetenz: 81/100 / Boardroom-Rhetorik: 67/100 / Strategisches EQ: 74/100 / nenne IMMER die konkreten Zahlen' — so root cause is the structured-JSON output schema (insight/strategy/action_steps/reflection) which sometimes returns purely generic template text without echoing dimension names. Consider adding a `dimensions` field to the chat response schema OR loosening test_5 to accept dim_hit≥1 (the review-request criterion). This is NOT a sync bug.
